description: This file contains helper functions for command-line interface parsing, processing repositories, and outputting various metrics related to bug localization and ranking evaluations, specifically for a project involving bug localization metrics and visualization.

methods.name: parse_cli_arguments
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments using inquirer to configure repository path, mode, iteration, and loop count, returning a SimpleNamespace with these settings.

methods.name: process_repos
methods.description: Processes a list of repository paths to generate bug ranking data, optionally with GUI data, and tracks the best rankings per bug.

methods.name: output_metrics_with_improvement
methods.description: Calculates and displays various metrics comparing GUI-enhanced and baseline bug rankings, including relative improvement, and outputs detailed tables.

methods.name: output_metrics
methods.description: Outputs evaluation metrics such as hits@k, MAP, MRR, and effectiveness to console and CSV, with optional improvement metric.

methods.name: output_big_metrics
methods.description: Appends evaluation metrics to 'bigMetrics.csv' for a given loop, without ranking details, including optional improvement.

methods.name: output_big_metrics_with_improvement
methods.description: Appends evaluation metrics with calculated improvement to 'bigMetrics.csv' for a given loop, without ranking details.
